text:
kevin: Heads-up — FinHealth asked for cost + error dashboards and trace hooks for their pilot by EOW. Need to align on a shipping cut and launch criteria. Quick sync?

maria: Got it. Can you paste their ask list so we can map to acceptance criteria?

kevin: Their asks (copied):
- per-route cost breakdown (tokens + infra estimate)
- session traces tied to model_version and route metadata
- error heatmap with example queries per fingerprint
- configurable sampling (they want to ramp for debug)
- alerts for error spikes + basic SLO monitoring (they expect p95 <150ms)

liam: We should be careful promising p95 SLA for hosted. For pilot we can provide visibility and a soft SLO. Engineering can't guarantee infra SLA yet.

sophia: Proposed minimal cut for pilot:
1) Dashboard: per-route cost card (estimated) + simple trend chart
2) Trace hooks: link traces to model_version for 2 critical routes
3) Error analytics: heatmap + sample viewer (redacted)
4) Sampling: default 1%, error-boost to 10% (opt-in)
Acceptance: FinHealth can open a trace, see model_version tag, and view a sample input in the UI.

anita: Engineering notes — tracing requires runtime tags on requests (route_id, model_version, token_count). ETA: ~3 dev sprints to add runtime hooks + 1 sprint for Console UX. Per-token exact infra cost is expensive; recommend estimate = token_count * model_unit_cost + small infra multiplier.

kevin: @anita that estimate approach sounds reasonable. We should be explicit in the UI that it's an estimate.

sophia: sample sampling config (for ops & docs):
```
sampling:
  default_rate: 0.01
  error_rate_boost: 0.1
  max_rate: 0.1
routes:
  - id: checkout
    capture_kv: true
  - id: pricing
    capture_kv: false
```

maria: Draft acceptance checklist (product):
- per-route cost card visible for pilot routes
- trace drilldown includes model_version and route metadata
- error heatmap + sample query viewer with redaction
- sampling control in Console (opt-in for customer)
- docs and customer note on estimate math & PII handling

liam: Ops concern — KV capture must run through redaction filters. Also token_count -> cost uses tokenization lib; make sure model unit cost config is per-model and versioned.

sre-bot: Canary pool available in us-west-2 next Thu. Recommend we run trace hook and sampling changes behind canary flag.

kevin: Decision for this thread: proceed with the proposed minimal cut, explicitly de-scope exact infra cost breakdown and long-tail route index for pilot. Next actions:
- maria: present acceptance checklist to FinHealth (Fri 10am PT)
- anita: draft tracing PRD with rollout & rollback plan by Wed
- sophia: dashboard mockups by Tue EOD
- ops-bot: create canary run ticket and schedule (ops)

maria: I'll run the customer call Fri 10am PT, @kevin pls join.

kevin: I'll join. Thanks everyone. :thumbsup: 

anita: Adding follow-ups to PRD: sampling cost delta metric, rollback steps, list of redacted fields to document.

ops-bot: Created ticket OPS-5234 for canary plan and assigned to eng-oncall.

sophia: Quick note — UI copy should say 'Estimated cost' with tooltip explaining method and accuracy.

kevin: Great point. Keep the customer expectation clear. We'll iterate after the pilot.

maria: OK locking in tasks. I'll post the acceptance checklist + mock links after Sophia shares mocks.

kevin: End of thread — thanks.
